Handyman Questions

What kind of odd jobs do you take on?

Most small jobs around the house and yard: assembly, mounting, small repairs, touch-ups and the tasks that never seem to get done. If you're not sure, just ask.

Can you do several small jobs in one visit?

Yes. Make a list and we'll tackle as much of it as we can in one trip.

How soon can you come?

We offer same-day service. Call or WhatsApp 705-562-9047 and we'll tell you when we can be there.

Do you give free estimates?

Always. Tell us what you need done — photos help — and we'll give you a free, no-obligation estimate.

Do you cover my area?

We take on odd jobs all over Greater Sudbury, from Copper Cliff and the South End to Garson, Falconbridge and Capreol. See all the areas we serve.
